title: White Sands | KEY.co
description_expanded: White Sands is a light-filled coastal retreat perfectly tailored for families, groups, and their four-legged companions. With four spacious bedrooms and four and a half bathrooms, this thoughtfully designed home invites relaxation and connection in a setting where modern comfort meets laid-back beach charm. The open-concept layout flows effortlessly from the inviting living room—complete with three plush sofas and a large TV—to the dining and kitchen areas, creating the ideal space for gathering after sun-soaked days. A screened-in porch offers a peaceful spot for morning coffee or evening conversations, all while enjoying the coastal breeze in comfort. Outdoors, guests can rinse off under the outdoor shower after beach adventures, then fire up the grill and dine al fresco beneath the Florida sky. With convenient features like in-home laundry, ample parking, and the option of a golf cart rental, every detail is in place for a seamless stay. Located just a short ride from the powdery white sands and emerald waters of Santa Rosa Beach, this pet-friendly haven blends effortless style with everyday ease. White Sands isn’t just a place to stay—it’s where lasting beach memories are made.
